method: Scheduled Pillar Two 30-day news refresh (15 Oct 2026): WebSearch plus fetching primary official pages for OECD, HK IRD, SG IRAS/MOF/SSO/laws.sg, and JP NTA. Items added only when date and content were confirmed against a fetched source.

coverage.OECD: Checked 15 Oct 2026: OECD model-rules and Sep announcement pages remain Cloudflare bot-blocked (curl 403 / challenge). Search index and EY Sep alert still point to the 11 Sep 2026 Inclusive Framework package (Admin Guidance / GIR / Full Legislative Review) as the latest substantive release — already catalogued. Central Record PDF fetched; CreationDate 15 May 2026 (already catalogued as oecd-2026-05-central-record). No post-11 Sep Pillar Two releases found.
coverage.HK: Checked 15 Oct 2026: IRD What's New fetched through 14 Oct 2026 CDTA-gazettal press release and 12 Oct fraud alert — no Pillar Two entries since the 8 Jun 2026 GIR XML update already catalogued. IRD GMT/HKMTT page fetched — Phase 2 of the Pillar Two Portal still stated as Q4 2026. No new official Pillar Two developments.
coverage.SG: Checked 15 Oct 2026: IRAS GloBE/DTT page fetched (Side-by-Side / Substance-based Tax Incentive Safe Harbour / QTI list still present; secondary RegFollower 14 Oct note summarises the same page — not treated as a new official release beyond the 6 Oct Bill passage). MOF newsroom fetched — posts after 6 Oct are non-Pillar Two (Temasek etc.). SSO still hosts Bill No. 22/2026 only; Acts-Supp browse showed no Finance (Income Taxes) Act 2026 gazette/assent page. laws.sg still shows Bill metadata without SSO Acts-Supp confirmation. Nothing new since the 6 Oct parliamentary passage already catalogued.
coverage.JP: Checked 15 Oct 2026: NTA 新着情報 fetched — newest entries (13 Oct 酒類輸出動向; 1 Oct 文書回答) are unrelated to Pillar Two. The 趣旨説明 for the 7 Aug 2026 circular remains listed as 令和8年10月9日 (already catalogued as jp-2026-10-09). NTA グローバル・ミニマム課税 hub fetched — no new guidance links beyond Aug Q&A / Oct 趣旨説明 already in the file. KPMG Japan e-Tax News 13 Oct is secondary coverage of the same 趣旨説明. No further Pillar Two administrative guidance or GIR schema updates.
